entries.baseline: The pre-pack core-only defaults compiled into BatchConfig / batch_run (identical values, no artifact)
entries.content: Core gate/ER operating declarations carried as baseline payload data: triple_threshold 0.25, review_band 0.25-0.50, er_threshold 0.40, er_cross_doc_min_p_same 0.85 (the cross-document merge floor), batch_cost_cap_usd 10.0, er_auto_merge form_variants_only, er_alias_sources text_attested_only, chunk_window_chars 1000 / chunk_min_chars 100. The gate these thresholds are calibrated for is the Jev gate typesafe/jev-1.13 — named here as measurement provenance; the binding itself lives in the connection-layer reference profile, never in this payload.
entries.delta: No value changes: the baseline pack reproduces the live core defaults exactly. The delta is the artifact — the defaults now exist as versioned, pin-verified data a resolution can start from, instead of compiled-in constants alone.
entries.gate: docs/PACK_DESIGN.md §3 classification (RUN defaults CORE-pinned; the merge-floor minimum deliberately not per-domain) + reference-profile pinning
entries.instrument: pipeline/batch.py BatchConfig defaults; pipeline/batch_run.py ER_XDOC_MERGE_MIN; docs/PACK_DESIGN.md §3 boundary classification
entries.population: Cross-domain record: the same values ran under the CUAD payload (certified p3b-v6 lineage), the BioRED payloads (the pilot rounds), and the Re-DocRED payload, each mirroring them as declarations
entries.treatment: General pack 0.1.0 payload declarations (metadata class per PACK_DESIGN §3 — BatchConfig governs live runs; the payload records the authored defaults)
entries.verdict: ADOPTED — the general pack's baseline conformance entry: the operating defaults a new user starts from. Changing any value is a pack version bump priced by a registered measurement, never an in-place edit.

entries.baseline: Pre-fix core templates carrying CUAD contract framing as the compiled-in default (the 'core default' prompt named the commercial-contract domain)
entries.content: Neutral core proposer/slot framing carried as payload data: proposer_framing, slot_framing, slot_rules — byte-equal to pipeline/proposer.py's TRIPLE_FRAMING_DEFAULT / SLOT_FRAMING_DEFAULT / SLOT_RULES_DEFAULT
entries.delta: CUAD prompts byte-identical before/after the domain-boundary fix; fiction's prompt delta is exactly the framing lines — no contract text and no corrective line on the core-only path. The general payload adds no framing of its own: its three values equal the core constants (asserted in staging tests).
entries.gate: The domain-boundary rule: domain content as data only; byte-equality proof required
entries.instrument: The domain-boundary test (measurement record); payload framing asserted equal to the proposer module constants
entries.population: The prompt surfaces of all families; proof population = CUAD (byte-identical rendered prompts) + fiction (core-only, declares no guidance)
entries.treatment: Post-fix payload framing declarations (the values this pack pins)
entries.verdict: ADOPTED — the general pack's framing is the measured neutral core text. Domain-flavored template residue found elsewhere in the core during the A2 audit is NOT carried into this payload; it is recorded in the project's internal log with its deferral reasons.

entries.baseline: The stage-4c fitted configuration (roster + sentence x standard, legacy answer format) on the same population
entries.content: JF-F1 direction slot on the pair judge (the answer format gains a direction field; BA answers swap endpoints at parse; symmetric relations never swap), over the F1 fitted configuration: roster + pair enumeration, sentence window, standard instruction
entries.delta: Conversion eta 0.1124 -> 0.2596; direction flips 131 -> 7; candidate precision 0.3464 -> 0.8381; orientation accuracy 0.9619
entries.gate: Stage-8 pre-registered gates (the JF-F1 design, §6): eta >= 0.21 PASS (0.2596); NONE-loss <= 392 PASS (258); flips <= 3% of kept PASS (7 of 2,756); candidate precision >= 0.55 PASS (0.8381); parse family <= 1% PASS (0 of 3,128)
entries.instrument: Stage-8 run record (the f1 scores) and the consistency-harness record. Also recorded as the Open Domain pack's entry DC-3
entries.population: Re-DocRED dev, the fitted 60 documents; 3,128 judged pairs
entries.treatment: JF-F1 direction slot (core mechanism), F1 variant declarations pair_judge_context sentence x pair_judge_instruction standard
entries.verdict: ADOPTED as a core mechanism and as this pack's recorded pair-judge baseline. The general payload declares the F1 variant (sentence x standard) but deliberately does NOT declare pair_judge_format: JF-F1 activation requires the inventory's symmetric set, which is domain-pack data (a pinned direction-declarations artefact) — a domain-neutral pack owns no inventory, and 'jf1' declared without its symmetric source fails validation, fail-closed.

entries.baseline: Sentence-only enumeration as executed in the S2 main run: 26,938 candidate pairs, realized judging ledger ≈ $18.68, ceiling-adjusted recall 0.2028 as re-priced under the ruled adjudication contract (2026-10-22; docs/ADJUDICATION.md, whitepaper §5.4)
entries.content: The enumeration operating point as the baseline window default: pair_window 'adjacent' (max_dist=1) + REC (deterministic roster surface recovery, the enumeration design §3 — core mechanism, no setup_config key)
entries.delta: 52,463 candidate pairs, projected judging $35.06 at the main run's realized per-pair rate; estimated ceiling-adjusted recall 0.1884 for the adopted point. Fit60 conversion cell (§10): REC-linked conversion eta_new 0.1403 against the registered floor 0.1287 — the combined point passes only with REC linking on. Recall figures restated 2026-10-22: the sentence-window figure read 'estimated 0.1346' at adoption, was measured 0.1265 under the original adjudication protocol, and is 0.2028 under the ruled contract (ĝ_B 0.841 -> 0.5244); the adopted point's 0.1884 was projected under the original adjudication and is not re-projected. The adoption is unchanged — it was chosen on coverage and the conversion cell, not on the recall pricing.
entries.gate: The enumeration decision (2026-10-21: adopt the measured optimum as the shipped default; the narrower sentence window stays available as the cheaper option) on the enumeration design's §5 recommendation + §10 cell gates G1-G3 PASS
entries.instrument: The enumeration design record (§§4-6, §10) — deterministic coverage table over the frozen S2 run artifacts ($0 analysis) + the funded fit60 conversion cell
entries.population: Re-DocRED dev, 500 documents (the main-run corpus); fit60 documents for the conversion cell
entries.treatment: pair_window 'adjacent' declared in the general payload; takes effect when a run or a specified pack selects pair enumeration
entries.verdict: ADOPTED as the baseline window default. The baseline does not force pair_enumeration on: packs that omit the switch keep the core free-proposal path, and a pack declaring its own pair_window (e.g. Bio Medical's 'sentence') overrides this default under resolution.

entries.baseline: Lab profiles naming exact models inline, as run provenance; no shipped connection preset
entries.content: Layer placement of the tested model bindings (the reference profile): proposer anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5, Jev gate typesafe/jev-1.13 (pinned product component), embedder openai/text-embedding-3-large, NER urchade/gliner_medium-v2.1, escalation anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5, drafting unbound (no preset model — the seat ships unbound and the user binds it explicitly) — carried in pipeline/reference_profile.py as the default connection preset. The general payload names no model, endpoint, or secret.
entries.delta: The measured pipeline bindings (proposer, Jev gate, embedder, NER) reproduce the tested combination exactly, so a default install reproduces the published measurements; the escalation seat carries the measured escalation model (Sonnet), and drafting ships unbound — exercised once in the lab, never part of the measured pipeline. (Cast text corrected to the current preset, 2026-10-22.) Any user edit is a custom binding, and run records state which binding produced the run.
entries.gate: The reference-profile decision (2026-10-21) + the three-layer rule (domain config declares capability tiers only; model names live in the connection layer and in provenance/reference-profile records)
entries.instrument: pipeline/reference_profile.py (the single home of the bindings); staging tests/test_reference_profile.py pins every binding to its pre-change literal
entries.population: All published measurements in the quality record (the CUAD, BioRED, and Re-DocRED lines were each measured under this combination or its recorded per-line equivalent)
entries.treatment: Reference profile as the shipped default connection preset (pre-filled, user-owned, editable)
entries.verdict: ADOPTED — recorded here so the general pack's defaults are reproducible end to end without putting model names into domain config. The pack carries the thresholds and operating points; the connection layer carries the bindings; secrets are environment-only at every layer.
